Good afternoon, Chidi. I checked transfer TRF-INV-88 for ₦250,000 (invoice INV-88) directly with the recipient bank. Although our side shows it as failed, the bank confirms that it was successfully credited to your Access Bank account 0234567891 on 21 November 2026 at 14:02:11 UTC.

Bank session ID: 000014261121140211000088.

Please check your account statement using those details. I have not resent the payment, to avoid a duplicate ₦250,000 transfer.

[after the person answered]

I understand this is frustrating, Chidi, but I can’t safely send another ₦250,000 while Access Bank’s final status for TRF-INV-88 confirms that the original transfer was credited to account 0234567891. Sending again now could create a duplicate payment.

Please ask Access Bank to trace the credit using session ID 000014261121140211000088 and the credit timestamp of 21 November 2026 at 14:02:11 UTC. If the bank confirms that the funds were not credited or were reversed, please send me that confirmation along with any corrected account details. The payment can then be reviewed further without risking a second debit for the same invoice.
